goal: Make peer message processing code easier for maintainers to navigate, scope, and review
Break up an oversized message dispatcher that handles every message type inline
agreement: Broad support for breaking up the monolithic handler (stickies-v, theStack, pablomartin4btc, maflcko)
Verified as a move-only refactor preserving thread safety and semantics (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds, l0rinc)
Nonblocking objection: separate helpers add caller ambiguity compared to a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P4 because reorganizing message handling code does not alter network relay behavior or DoS resistance
Internal code reorganization offers no direct performance or security benefit to peer-to-peer operations
